box_addressed: P3 — Compare against LogMap and AML, or mark unavailable arms CANNOT_CHECK.
what_this_artifact_is: A per-arm disposition over comparator systems already exercised in the P3 development record. It creates no new result. It records, for each arm, whether a scored comparison exists, and where it does not, the exact evidenced reason and the exact conditions that would promote the arm to scorable.

case_universe.note: One historical public case. No population estimand, confidence interval or p value is carried by this artifact or by the V21 result it cites.

evidence.role: native alignment output of the arm
common-universe scoring of this arm against the frozen reference

explicitly_not_claimed: LogMap is inferior or superior to any other arm
arms.what_is_true_instead: LogMap 4.0 runs. Its runtime is bound to an exact 90/90 dependency closure and it has terminated normally with exit code 0. What does not exist is a LogMap MATCHING-mode alignment over the scored case, admitted through the frozen V21 identity interface. The arm is unbound for scoring, not unavailable.

blocking_conditions.condition: Matching mode has only ever been exercised on a synthetic smoke universe, never on the scored case.
blocking_conditions.detail: V6 preflight declares authority RUNTIME_AND_NATIVE_ARTIFACT_PREFLIGHT_ONLY__NO_PERFORMANCE_OR_SCIENTIFIC_OUTCOME_AUTHORITY over ontologies named urn:orion:p3:v6:smoke:source / :target, and carries the interpretation guard that rows were not compared to gold. Its declared output logmap2_mappings.rdf is recorded by digest only and is not retained in the tree.

blocking_conditions.condition: The retained LogMap output on the real case is REPAIR mode, not matching. A repair of another system's mappings is not that system's own alignment and cannot be scored as an independent arm.
blocking_conditions.detail: V11 obtained this file by repairing the V9 filtered mapping input. Its own claim boundary states it does not establish mapping correctness, performance, harm, coverage, transport or superiority.

blocking_conditions.condition: Every retained LogMap row wraps its IRIs in Optional.of(...), which the frozen V21 identity decoder rejects.
blocking_conditions.detail: The V21 decoder admits an entity string only if the whole string matches the frozen absolute-IRI grammar and decoding is an identity transform with no wrapper removal. Stripping Optional.of(...) after seeing the reference would be exactly the post-outcome normalization V11 forbade its successor from performing.

blocking_conditions.condition: No reproducible runtime pin exists for the official MELT LogMap wrapper.
blocking_conditions.detail: The wrapper is pinned at ernestojimenezruiz/logmap-melt@e891cea083cf5660776a59cc1f06578acc8ca229, but its POM resolves master-SNAPSHOT on openjdk:8-jre-alpine. That is provenance, not a reproducible runtime, until dependency and image digests are frozen.

promotion_conditions: Freeze a LogMap matching-mode invocation (not repair) against the scored case's exact source and target ontology hashes, one attempt, no retry.
Retain the native alignment artifact in the tree, not only its digest.

Resolve LM-B3 at the source: either obtain unwrapped IRIs from a corrected native invocation, or freeze an explicit, pre-outcome interface amendment that declares Optional.of(...) unwrapping part of the admitted grammar. Never strip the wrapper after reference access.
Pin the MELT wrapper's dependency and image digests, or bind a non-MELT invocation path with its own frozen closure.
Re-verify the RDF header defect recorded in V6 (duplicate_ontology_1_call_found: true, both onto1 and onto2 naming ontology 1) so alignment role assignment is decidable from the artifact.

search_scope_for_the_absence_claim.claim: No LogMap matching-mode alignment artifact over a scored case exists anywhere on origin/main.
search_scope_for_the_absence_claim.how_searched: git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main filtered case-insensitively for 'logmap'; every non-JAR hit inspected. Also searched path patterns logmap_mappings, logmap_anchors, logmap_overestimation and logmap2_mappings across the whole tree.
search_scope_for_the_absence_claim.result: All retained LogMap artifacts are mappings_repaired_with_LogMap.* or filtered_mappings_for_LogMap_repair.txt. Matching-mode outputs: 0 retained.
search_scope_for_the_absence_claim.note: Stated as a searched-and-absent claim with its scope named, not as an inference from a command that printed nothing.

box_verdict.box: Compare against LogMap and AML, or mark unavailable arms CANNOT_CHECK.
box_verdict.how: AML executed in matching mode and scored against the frozen reference on the case (V16 + V21 receipts). LogMap marked CANNOT_CHECK with four evidenced blocking conditions and explicit promotion conditions. The box's disjunction is satisfied by the second branch for the arm that has no scored comparison.
box_verdict.not_claimed: That the comparison is complete, population-valid, or a current-SOTA claim. The V21 boundary stands unchanged.

out_of_scope_boxes.official RDF reference alignments and ME: NOT addressed. Official RDF reference is used (REFERENCE_FROZEN_V21.rdf, sha256 0afb0f2c9764201d91c226c5fb60d4b25425168acf6c2604fb191be906e9ec16), but scoring is performed by the house evaluator common_pair_evaluator_v21.py, not by MELT. This box remains open.
out_of_scope_boxes.at least one natural ontology-pair track: NOT addressed. The only scored case is OAEI 2004 test-103, itself a generated benchmark track. This box remains open and requires a natural pair.
